title: Pride Banners
description: Adds in pride flag banner patterns!
body:
Pride Banners! You can already make some of them, but I wanted more! And to more easily craft them. So, now you can! 

Currently, this mod adds in 13 different pride flags with more to come.

So, enjoy your new banners! They are all crafted in the loom!

**Disclaimer!!**
To craft these banners, use a white banner with white dye. Otherwise, the flags will be off color.
